purpose: Read only the cell metadata of the object explicitly linked as Analysis anndata by the IBDverse site, to test whether model sample-count metadata is recoverable.
selection_basis: The source site labels this object Analysis anndata (421 individuals); the deployed config names cross_tissue-analysis_anndata.h5ad and uses Genotyping_ID plus predicted_labels_tissue. File equivalence is unproven and must remain explicit.
forbidden: Do not read X, raw, expression layers or individual genotype values. Do not export individual identifiers. Do not equate RNA eligibility counts with executed genotype-model N, or infer a directly observed PC count from residual df. No new association or shared-signal analysis.
before_inspection: This access plan is written before HDF5 metadata or cell-group counts in this object have been inspected. The 95 blood donors in the separate sample metadata and prior residual df 69/66 are already known.
